# prepared-code(1)

## NAME

prepared-code - formatted attributes in code

<a id="_synopsis"></a>
## SYNOPSIS

**prepared-code**

<a id="_description"></a>
## DESCRIPTION

```
Formatting: {bold} / {frozen} / {normal} / {link}
Literal references: \{bold} / {bold\}
```

```
Escaped: {bold} / {frozen} / {normal} / {link}
```

```
Macros: {alias} / {note} / {term}
```

```rust
// Highlighted: {alias} / {link} / {term}
```
